text:
maria: Heads-up — found inconsistent examples for /v1/generate in the API reference. Some examples use `max_new_tokens`, others use `max_tokens`. Also saw a request example that uses an array where we usually use an object. This is causing confusion in SDK snippets and the migration notes. Can someone help coordinate a small docs PR?

alex: Thanks for flagging. Do you have the exact page link? I'll grep the OpenAPI and examples in the repo.

maria: https://docs.redwood.ai/reference/generate#request — the inline example near "Request body" is the one that mixes names. I'll paste the snippet in the PR.

sam: I can update the SDK snippets (py/js). We should standardize on `max_new_tokens` as canonical in docs and add a short migration note. @jordan can you confirm the runtime accepts both?

jordan: Runtime accepts both for backwards compat, but canonical name we want in docs is `max_new_tokens`. It avoids ambiguity with total-token/budget vs new tokens. Behavior: we map `max_tokens` -> `max_new_tokens` internally currently. Recommend wording: "Both are accepted for now; prefer `max_new_tokens`."

maria: I'll open a docs PR that: 1) replace `max_tokens` -> `max_new_tokens` in examples, 2) fix the request example shape (object vs array), 3) update Python snippet and JS camelCase note, and 4) add a small migration note. Drafting PR now (draft #5123).

sam: For SDKs: Python stays `max_new_tokens`, JS uses `maxNewTokens`. I'll prepare a small snippet in the PR and include the exact call patterns we test in our snippets tests. Also add a one-liner about camelCase mapping.

alex: There's also a components/examples entry in the OpenAPI that still has `max_tokens` in the example payload — I can patch that in the same PR so generated clients pick up correct examples.

maria: Great — assigning reviewers @alex and @sam. I'll add a note to the PR about updating the examples tests and add a TODO to follow-up on the migration guide once this lands.

docs-bot: docs-ci: Preview site build passed for PR #5123 :white_check_mark: (staging preview: https://deploy-preview-5123--docs.redwood.ai)

jordan: :thumbsup: For migration guide follow-up, let's avoid changing semantics in the guide. Suggest: "If your app relied on `max_tokens` as total allowed tokens, confirm mapping in your client; prefer explicit `max_total_tokens` if/when we add it." We can refine after the docs PR merges.

sam: I'll open an SDK PR referencing #5123 and include a changelog note: "docs: standardize generate examples to `max_new_tokens`". I'll also run snippet tests locally.

maria: Awesome — pushing the docs PR now and will ping here when ready for review. Thanks all!
